name: Atlas AI Revenue Engine
description: Atlas AI Revenue Engine runs AI voice and SMS agents that call and text leads, answer inbound calls, book appointments and hand chats to live agents.

events.d: Queue an AI agent call to a phone number from a selected campaign.
Add a contact with custom fields to a campaign for AI calling.
Update a contact's name, phone number, timezone or custom fields in a campaign.
Get a campaign contact's details by contact ID.
Find call records by campaign, phone number, date range, type or outcome.
Get a call's transcript, summary, status and recording URL by call ID.
Find appointments booked by the AI agent in a campaign, optionally for one call.
Start an AI SMS conversation with a contact now or at a scheduled time.
Send a live agent's reply in a chat session that is in human handoff.
Turn human handoff on or off for a contact's chat conversation in a chosen campaign.
